title: fix(fields): the grid reads a boolean column as a boolean in its requiredWhen / readonlyWhen rules
body:

Fixes #34972

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi3ezPzTysQPDEjmVz
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：主从表单的行内表格在计算每个单元格的 `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` 时，把布尔列（下拉框里存的字符串 `'true'` / `'false'`）按真正的布尔值来读；单元格显示的内容和保存出去的数据都不变。
- 为什么改：布尔字段在表格里被画成选项值为字符串的下拉框，`record.won == true` 拿字符串去比布尔，必填标记和只读锁显示的状态与服务端相反；服务端（#34965 之后）按布尔判定，于是用户看到表格没提示、保存却被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只改规则求值时看到的那份行数据，读法与服务端写入归一化 `BOOLEAN_READINGS` 一致（`'true'`/`'1'`/`1` 与 `'false'`/`'0'`/`0`）。识别布尔列靠"select 且恰好两个选项 `'true'`/`'false'`"这一形状：若某个真正的 select 字段恰好就用这两个字符串当选项，它在规则里会被读成布尔（见 Acceptance notes）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`（`ruleRecordOf`、`isBooleanSelectColumn` 与 `cellRules` 的改动）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx`（末尾新增的 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx`（需先构建 fields 的依赖闭包），预期 51 个测试全部通过，其中新增 4 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/fields` — `GridField` cell rules.** `cellRules` used to hand the raw row to `resolveFieldRuleState`. A boolean / toggle child field is derived by `@object-ui/plugin-form` (`fieldTypeToColumnType`, `optionsFor` in `deriveMasterDetail.ts`) into a `select` column whose options store the strings `'true'` / `'false'`, and the select cell writes that string into the row. So `record.won == true` compared a string, and the required marker / readonly lock showed the opposite of what the server enforces.
  - New `isBooleanSelectColumn`: a `select` column whose exactly two options are `'true'` and `'false'` (the derived shape; a grid column carries no field definition, so the option pair is what names the type here).
  - New `ruleRecordOf`: the row the predicate reads as `record`, with each boolean column's cell read through `BOOLEAN_READINGS`, the same readings and comparison (SameValueZero, via `Map`) as the engine's write normalisation from #34965. Every other value is left as is. It copies only when a cell is actually read, and never mutates the row.
  - Boolean columns are taken from **all** columns (shown or `defaultHidden`), since a predicate may read any cell.
- `readonlyWhen` shares the same path (`cellRules`), so it is covered. The grid has no `visibleWhen` reader; nothing to change there.
- What the cell displays and what the row saves are unchanged. The save path does send the string, but since #34965 the engine stores it as a boolean, so the stored value is already the boolean; this PR does not touch the save path.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/fields` patch, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared harness `GridField.test.tsx`, "a boolean column read as a boolean by the cell rules":
- `requiredWhen: record.won == true`: the row holding `'true'` gets the required marker, the row holding `'false'` gets none.
- A stored boolean `true` reads the same as `'true'`, and the row value the select wrote stays `'true'` (no `onChange`).
- `readonlyWhen: record.won == true`: `'true'` locks the cell, `'false'` does not.
- CONTROL: a non-boolean select column (`open` / `closed`) keeps its string value in the predicate.

## Acceptance notes

- **Detection by option shape.** The column carries no field type (the spec's `InlineGridColumn` has no such key, and adding one is a contract change), so a boolean column is recognised by its derived option pair. A genuine `select` child field whose options are exactly `'true'` and `'false'` would also be read as a boolean in the rules, while the server keeps it a string. The exact alternative is a host-supplied prop naming the boolean columns from the child schema (the pattern `lookupAutofill` / `columnCurrencies` already follow), which touches `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, outside this claim's file surface.
- **Live reading: NOT MEASURED.** Reason: no example app has a child object whose `requiredWhen` reads a boolean field (the showcase's `requiredWhen` rules on `invoice` read `status`), so a live reading needs authoring a new child object in an example plus a Console build and a browser run. The jsdom pins above render the real `GridField` over the derived column shape instead.
